scenarios.title: final delivery audits every rendered module, navigation target and browser console
captures seven requested final-delivery views from the running application
every registered route is reachable and unknown paths show a recoverable 404
desktop Dashboard has honest empty states, working links and no external API calls
theme changes persist across reload and settings controls remain synchronized
mobile navigation reaches all centers and layouts fit narrow touch screens
manifest, original icons, install guidance and service-worker registration are usable
offline reload opens the public shell and caches exclude pages and private requests
new service-worker version waits for user confirmation, reloads and removes only stale app cache
profile saves to the real database; own JSON/CSV exports and CSRF controls
real private media validates bytes, rejects cross-user reads, and deletes file plus metadata
confirmed deletion removes Auth, SQL and private storage including orphan files
auth callbacks reject malformed input and prevent caching
real local email signup, resend, PKCE verification, signin, signout and password recovery
remote session revocation preserves an offline outbox across account isolation and original-account reauthentication
real desktop/mobile sync, durable offline edits, explicit conflicts, idempotent lost-ack retry and logout isolation
the fixed brand hero and all local editorial pictures load without an external image service
reduced-motion preferences disable ambient and parallax motion
image failure has a readable fallback and does not break genuine navigation
records desktop motion pacing without claiming real-phone performance
